title: Responsible Business Conduct Amendment Directions (Nine Circulars) - Loan Recovery Framework
description: <cite index="60-1,60-2">The RBI issued nine circulars on August 6, 2026 to create a unified framework for loan recovery practices.</cite> <cite index="60-3">The directions apply from January 1, 2027, with the original proposed date of October 1, 2026 deferred to allow lenders time for transition.</cite> <cite index="34-10,34-11">The RBI consolidated recovery-conduct standards that apply uniformly to banks, NBFCs and housing finance companies, with key changes including a refined definition of recovery agency, mandatory borrower compensation as a policy element, and device-locking prohibition by default.</cite>
